proposals.title: Am Bachufer
proposals.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished 2:3 vertical group illustration, a genuinely NEW composition: four young female knights taking a relaxed midday campfire break on a tranquil stream bank beneath a large spreading oak. All four sit on TWO simple fallen logs arranged as a very open shallow semicircle, TWO women per log, with visible breathing room between bodies. A small stone-ringed fire occupies the open ground in front, safely separated from boots, cat and bird. A little stream, summer meadow flowers, rolling pasture and blue sky make the setting peaceful and rural. Clear high midday daylight and short soft shadows, not sunset. No castle or village required. Quiet shared smiles and a conversational moment.

MANDATORY STYLE (verbatim): Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.

The FIVE input images are character/design references, never edit targets. Reference 1 is Oweta Draig: youthful 17-year-old knight, teal eyes, SHORT red hair with TWO LOW short side pigtails, black armor with RED trim and BLACK dragon chest emblem. Reference 2 is Rianna Wyrm: amber eyes, LONG red hair with TWO HIGH long twin tails, BLACK-and-GOLD armor with a BLACK dragon centered on a YELLOW breastplate; also her white horse Goldlöckchen and plump ginger cat. Reference 3 is Lefraye Gafyr: amber eyes, LONG red hair in ONE HIGH ponytail, dark ranger armor with gold shoulders and trim, red shoulder gems, dark scarf and gold paired-GOAT chest emblem; also dark-bay Thalena and a small black thrush. Reference 4 is Caralyn Chwedonol: teal eyes, LONG LOOSE auburn-red hair, friendly open face, GREEN-and-GOLD surcoat and dark armor, golden SEA-WOMAN/MERMAID chest emblem, not a lion. Reference 5 is Heulwen: chestnut coat, flaxen mane, broad white blaze and red/black Draig tack. Preserve all four distinct hairstyles, eye colors, face shapes and armor designs. Do NOT turn the four redheads into duplicates. No helmets obscure their faces.

EXACT cast: FOUR women + FOUR horses + ONE ginger tabby cat + ONE small black thrush. All FOUR women are clearly visible in three-quarter conversational poses, looking pleasantly at one another. Left log: Rianna and Oweta, right log: Caralyn and Lefraye. Hands lie simply on each woman's own knee or the log, relaxed fingers, no exaggerated gestures or crossed arms. Each woman has EXACTLY TWO arms and TWO legs, naturally seated knees and boots resting on the ground; maintain clear body ownership, no overlapping legs across people, no merged armor, no spare hands. Face, hair and upper armor remain unobstructed.

Midground horses are naturally spread at different angles in the meadow, but all FOUR separate bodies and FOUR separate heads can be counted: (1) Heulwen chestnut/flaxen/white blaze, red-and-black tack; (2) Goldlöckchen WHITE with extraordinarily voluminous CURLY GOLD mane, black-and-gold tack; (3) Thalena DARK BAY with BLACK mane and small WHITE forehead star, dark/gold goat tack; (4) Eure Hufigkeit CHESTNUT with flaxen mane and broad WHITE blaze, GREEN-and-GOLD tack bearing the sea-woman emblem. The two chestnut horses are distinct individuals. Do not merge horses or invent leg counts. Give clear silhouettes and natural grazing/resting anatomy; grass may obscure their hooves naturally.

Sir Fressbert is exactly ONE plump orange tabby with pale muzzle/chest, curled comfortably on a little blanket NEXT TO Rianna, safely away from fire. Agravaine/Vain is exactly ONE SMALL black song-thrush with yellow-orange beak and two small feet, perched on a low separate branch BESIDE Lefraye; NOT a raven or raptor and NEVER in/over the fire.
A modest cooking pot rests BESIDE the small fire on firm ground; only a couple of rolled packs and a simple cloth with bread. Keep the setting uncluttered; no bowls, cups or weapons in hands. All objects have physically credible support. Natural, friendly relaxed rest, no heroic formation or posed lineup, no extra figures, animals or objects. No goldfish, fishbowl, dog, modern objects, inscriptions, labels, panels, collage, watermark or border. Finished anatomically coherent illustration.
proposals.correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is a reference ONLY for the facial marking of Heulwen, the far-left chestnut horse.
Make ONE tiny localized correction to image 1: on the FAR-LEFT chestnut horse Heulwen, replace the currently small isolated white forehead mark with Heulwen's real broad continuous WHITE BLAZE. The blaze runs from beneath the forelock down the center of the forehead and nasal bridge all the way toward the muzzle, exactly like reference image 2. Keep the same chestnut coat on the sides of the face, pale flaxen mane, dark eye, brown bridle crossing OVER the white blaze, head pose and proportions. The marking must be clearly visible as one continuous blaze, not a forehead star and not a solid white horse face.
STRICT INVARIANTS: Change ONLY the paint/color of this one horse's facial marking. Preserve the entire rest of image 1 exactly: four women, their poses, faces, eyes, hairstyles, hands and eight boots, armor and heraldry; all four horses and their poses; one cat, one small black bird; campfire, kettle, bread, stream, tree, flowers; image layout, framing, resolution, 2:3 ratio, outlines, lighting and midday anime cel-shading. Do not regenerate, redesign, add, remove, move or crop anything. No other edits. No text or watermark.

proposals.title: Am Obstgartenrand
proposals.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 2:3 vertical anime illustration, a fresh proposal for Oweta's quartet. This is a new scene, not a collage or a character sheet.
Style preset verbatim: Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.

SCENE: A relaxed bright MIDDAY rest at the edge of an old apple orchard overlooking green open pasture. Soft dappled shade, blue sky, short midday shadows, a few apples still on branches. Four young female knights sit on a low dry-stone orchard wall in a gentle shallow arc, talking naturally and enjoying a quiet country pause. A small stone-ringed campfire burns on CLEAR EARTH in the lower foreground offset to the left, safely well in front of the people and animals. One modest cooking pot beside it. Calm, idyllic, friendly. A restrained travel blanket and bread packet. Few props; no evening lighting.

IDENTITY REFERENCES, use the supplied images to retain exact faces, hairstyles and the existing armor, but invent the orchard setting and poses:
Image 1 OWETA DRAIG: short red hair in TWO LOW SHORT PIGTAILS near the nape, teal eyes, calm quietly amused face, black armor with RED trim and black Draig dragon chest. Left-center seat, hands simply resting on her own knees.
Image 2 RIANNA WYRM: long red hair in TWO HIGH LONG TWIN TAILS, amber eyes, confident amused expression, BLACK/GOLD armor, BLACK DRAGON on a YELLOW chest. Left seat beside Oweta, both hands relaxed and clearly attached to her own forearms. This image also defines Goldlöckchen and Sir Fressbert.
Image 3 LEFRAYE GAFYR: long red hair in ONE HIGH PONYTAIL, amber eyes, dark ranger armor, dark scarf, GOLD pauldrons with small red gems, GOLD PAIRED GOAT emblem. Right seat, warm dry smile, one hand resting on her own knee and other on the wall. Bow and quiver simply leaned beside the wall, not held. This image also defines Thalena and Vain.
Image 4 CARALYN CHWEDONOL: long LOOSE AUBURN RED HAIR, teal eyes, open cheerful expression, GREEN/GOLD surcoat over dark armor, golden heraldic MERMAID/sea-woman from her exact reference. Right-center seat beside Lefraye; one simple tin mug held naturally in ONE hand, other hand on her own lap.
All four are distinct individuals, all four faces plainly visible, keep their different hairstyles and eye colors. Natural young-adult proportions, no sexualization. Helmets and gauntlets set aside if needed. Keep the intended clothing and heraldry from each own reference; never exchange arms, faces, hair, colors or emblems between women.

ANIMALS: Exactly FOUR separate horses graze calmly in the pasture beyond the low orchard fence, each with one separate coherent body and head and natural horse anatomy. Space them naturally, not a rigid lineup, but make all four easy to count. The wall/fence may naturally occlude their lower legs.
1 Heulwen, reference image 5: chestnut coat, pale flaxen mane, broad white face blaze, red/black Draig saddle cloth.
2 Goldlöckchen, from image 2: WHITE coat and exceptionally voluminous CURLY GOLDEN mane, black/gold Wyrm tack.
3 Thalena, from image 3: DARK BAY coat, BLACK mane/tail, tiny white forehead star, dark/gold Gafyr tack.
4 Eure Hufigkeit, visually verified design described here: chestnut coat, pale flaxen mane, broad white blaze, GREEN/GOLD tack with golden sea-woman crest. Distinct from Heulwen.
Exactly ONE plump ginger tabby cat SIR FRESSBERT with pale muzzle and chest, resting on the blanket at Rianna's side, safely far from fire. Exactly ONE SMALL black song-thrush VAIN perched on a low orchard branch beside Lefraye; a little blackbird with delicate feet and yellow bill, NOT a raven, NOT a raptor.

ANATOMY AND FRAMING: Four well-separated seated silhouettes. Each woman exactly two arms and two legs; simple untangled limb placement and ordinary relaxed five-finger hands. Their feet touch the ground beneath their own bodies. Do not cross or entwine different people's legs. No leaning hands on someone else's limb. Keep all heads and most bodies within frame, with readable faces and clear foreground fire. Preserve calm natural expressions rather than extreme laughter. Keep cat and bird separate from hands and armor. All animals remain physically plausible and correctly scaled.
Exact count: FOUR women, FOUR horses, ONE ginger cat, ONE small black thrush. No additional people, horses or animals. NO goldfish, fishbowl, dogs, raven, extra limbs, duplicate hands, fused boots, extra horse heads, text, labels, watermarks, decorative border or panels.

proposals.title: Hügelrast unter Birken
proposals.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: ONE new portrait 2:3 group illustration proposal, a complete single scene with no panels, text or border.
Scene: four young female knights enjoying a relaxed midday rest around a SMALL stone-ringed cooking fire on an open hilltop meadow under a few graceful birch trees. A wide green rural valley and soft distant hills under a clear blue NOON sky. Sun high overhead, small soft shadows, fresh daylight. Peaceful, friendly, intimate and idyllic, not a battle scene.
Style preset: Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
The five input images are REFERENCE IMAGES for exact identities and existing armor/animal designs, not edit targets or layout references. Reference 1 Oweta Draig; reference 2 Rianna Wyrm with her white horse and ginger cat; reference 3 Lefraye Gafyr with her dark horse and black thrush; reference 4 Caralyn Chwedonol; reference 5 Heulwen, Oweta's horse.
Exactly FOUR women. Preserve the FOUR DISTINCT red-haired identities:
Oweta: short red hair in TWO LOW short pigtails, teal eyes, black armor with red trim and black dragon chest emblem, calm dry-witted warm smile.
Rianna: long red hair in TWO HIGH LONG twin tails, amber eyes, black and gold armor with a BLACK dragon on GOLD-YELLOW breastplate, slightly amused confident smile.
Lefraye: long red hair in ONE HIGH ponytail, amber eyes, dark ranger armor, gold pauldrons with red gems, dark scarf, paired gold goat chest emblem. Easy small grin. Her bow/quiver rest nearby on the ground, no weapon in hand.
Caralyn: long LOOSE auburn hair, teal eyes, cheerful open face, dark armor with GREEN and gold surcoat and the golden sea-woman/mermaid emblem of the reference. No ponytails on Caralyn.
Composition: lowish eye-level camera. Four women sit on low simple camping stools or flat rocks in a shallow open arc around the small fire. Arrange from left to right Rianna, Oweta, Caralyn, Lefraye. Each is clearly separate, face and whole seated body readable. Give EACH her OWN visible pair of legs and feet, naturally bent, not crossed or tangled with anybody else's. Feet planted comfortably on the grass, natural boot positions. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands per woman; hands are simple, relaxed and resting on her OWN knees, lap or seat. No reaching across anybody, no complicated grasping, no joined hands, no cup or bowl to multiply fingers. Anatomically coherent shoulders, elbows, hips and knees; no extra hands, arms, legs or feet. Friends glance towards one another with easy smiles. Oweta is the calm social anchor, no throne or command pose.
All animals included and separate: exactly FOUR HORSES peacefully grazing in the middle distance beyond the women in a natural staggered arrangement with all four heads clearly countable. Do not merge or duplicate horse bodies. Heulwen is CHESTNUT with a pale flaxen mane, broad white facial blaze and RED/BLACK Draig tack from reference 5. Goldlöckchen is WHITE with an exceptionally voluminous CURLY GOLD mane and BLACK/GOLD tack from reference 2. Thalena is DARK BAY with BLACK mane/tail and tiny white forehead star from reference 3. Eure Hufigkeit is another separate CHESTNUT horse with pale flaxen mane, broad white blaze, and GREEN/GOLD sea-woman house tack. These two chestnut horses are distinct individuals with different tack, no combined neck/body.
Exactly ONE plump ginger tabby cat with cream chest and muzzle (Sir Fressbert) lies in the sunshine on a small folded blanket next to Rianna. Exactly ONE SMALL black thrush songbird with yellowish bill (Agravaine/Vain) perches on a thin low birch branch near Lefraye, well away from the flame. It is NOT a raven or a raptor.
Little clutter: a modest travel sack, a rolled blanket and a small cooking pot near the fire are enough. Keep an unambiguous gap between fire and bodies/animals. Lush grass and a few wildflowers; natural birches frame, not obscure the faces. Clear breathing room throughout. All four women remain recognizably their reference designs.
Avoid: sunset, dusk, night, dramatic orange light, large bonfire, extra people, men, extra animals, goldfish, fishbowls, dogs, duplicated characters, blended hairstyles, swapped house colors, hidden or merged limbs, extra toes/fingers, disconnected horse legs, cropped-off faces, captions, watermark, frame, collage.
